findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stake_check_domains · Public sink: stake_check_domains · Destructive: stake_check_domains.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stake_check_domains · Public sink: stake_check_domains · Destructive: stake_check_domains

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
